summary: This round adds three things to the round-1 DNS and error-message fix: an owner sign-in flow for the Open link, a referrer-policy fix on the handoff page, and a docs note to run `npm install` before the first build. Halo's Open link now goes through `/__halo/signin`, which skips the handoff when the browser already has a session for that creator host. The handoff consent page now sends `Referrer-Policy: same-origin`, so its form POST carries the real Origin header instead of `null`. A real-Chromium temp test covers owner and member sign-in, the Origin header, the session shortcut, and a stale cookie. A jsdom test covers the new link. The database-outage exemption is acceptable. I found no defects, and the change is ready.
